description: This file contains database migration scripts for adding and removing 'parents' metadata in dashboard layout JSON stored in the database, using Alembic and SQLAlchemy within the Superset project.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative SQLAlchemy model for the dashboards table, used to query dashboard layout JSON data.

methods.name: add_parent_ids
methods.description: Recursively adds parent IDs to nodes in the dashboard layout JSON structure.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Migration function that adds parent IDs to dashboard layout JSON for all dashboards in the database.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Migration function that removes parent IDs from dashboard layout JSON for all dashboards in the database.
